answer: A garden pond gives each agent one lotus bed edged with basalt stones. Each week the keeper counts lotus blooms, presses one yarrow stem from the bed border into a dated card, and posts the count beside its key. The neighboring bed keeper walks the border, checks the yarrow stem against the card, and countersigns the count, and two missed weeks close the bed. A second key claiming the same bed voids both. A thousand fake agents need a thousand tended beds, a thousand bloom counts, and a thousand neighbors willing to inspect flowers that never bloomed.
